factor_specs.proxy: DPL_KR_v3 (DeepSet Set Module + Per-stock Score Head MLP + Decision-induced Ranking Clipping + Continuous Concentration Softmax + STE Top-K + Projection-after-Normalize + Partial Adjustment + Sharpe surrogate loss 3-term composite)
factor_specs.formula: scores_t = ScoreHeadMLP(concat(X_t, ρ(Σ_i φ(X_t,i)/N_t))); s_t = clip(scores_t, -3, 3); w_raw = softmax(s_t / τ); top_K = argsort(w_raw)[N-20:]; w_topk = w_raw[top_K] / Σ w_raw[top_K] (STE during train); w_t^new = PAN(w_topk, bounds=[0,0.20]); w_t = α · w_t^new + (1-α) · w_{t-1} with α=0.6
factor_specs.formula_loss: L_total = -E[r_p]/(σ(r_p)+ε) + λ_to · |Δw| · 0.0015 · 2 + λ_conc · (HHI(w) - 0.10)^2,  HHI(w) = Σ_i w_i²
factor_specs.lag_rule: PIT C1~C15 strict + Purged WF 1m embargo (López de Prado 2018 Ch 7)

mechanism_description: Direct Portfolio Learning (DPL) Original paradigm — features → portfolio weights end-to-end NN backprop with utility loss (You-Zhang 2025 RFS). KR equity universe v3 redesigned 2nd application (v1 REJECT post-EW collapse + over-param + Gumbel hard top-K). 입력: 80 PIT-clean features (v2 inherit FMP r² family-balanced) × 124 sig_dates (2016-01 ~ 2026-04, post macro-prefix drop + WT007 macro residue drop + 24m warm-up) × ~500 stocks per sig_date (KR_TOP500_LIQ1E8 2e8 strict at alpha-emit). Architecture: DeepSet Set Module (6K params permutation-invariant Zaheer 2017) → concat per-stock X_t (R^80) + cross-section summary c_t (R^16) → Score Head MLP (8.3K params 3-layer 96→64→32→1) → s_t score per stock → Decision-induced ranking clip [-3,3] (Wang-Hasuike 2026 §3) → Continuous concentration softmax (τ ∈ {0.5, 1.0, 2.0} grid, NOT Gumbel hard top-K of v1) → STE top-K (straight-through estimator, differentiable surrogate) → Projection-after-Normalize iterative (clip [0, 0.20] → L1 normalize → check → iter max 3) → Partial adjustment α=0.6 (Wang-Hasuike 2026 §3-4). Loss: Sharpe surrogate -E[r_p]/(σ(r_p)+ε) + λ_to · |Δw|·0.0015·2 (round-trip × 2, λ_to ∈ {1.0, 2.0, 4.0} grid) + λ_conc · (HHI(w) - 0.10)² (concentration penalty, λ_conc ∈ {0.5, 1.0, 2.0} grid). Total params: ~17K (vs v1 165K 10× reduction). Walk-forward 5 windows shift-12m overlapping + 1m purged embargo. 20 random search × 5 WF = 100 trials → DSR Bailey-LdP n_trials=100 deflation. 7-axis admission gates G0~G7 (PIT + SR≥1.0 + cor<0.5/0.3 + Harvey-t≥3.0 5-spec + DSR Z≥1.5 + cost Pareto + AX-008≥2/3 + HHI>0.06 strict). Anti-fabrication: rawdata.parquet sha256 c86e4ae5... binding (v5 inherit) + bt_result.rds SHA256 (Forge mandate) + self_synthesis_used=false strict declare + audit obligation (v4 lesson). v3 paradigm distinction: Original DPL = standalone alpha (1715 외부 종속성 X), NOT RC. RC paradigm v3~v5 L-330 scope retire (cor 1.0 architectural OR bad NAV-level inverse). v3 Universe 자유 KR_TOP500_LIQ1E8 → cor < 0.3 (4th source) / < 0.5 (substitution) achievable. 5-source academic backbone: Zhang-Wu-Chen 2021 China A-share SR 2.0 + Zhong DSPO 2024 NYSE return 121.94% + Epstein-Sadhwani-Giesecke 2025 US Sharpe 0.3→0.7 + Wood-Roberts-Zohren 2026 50 futures 2× CTA + You-Zhang 2025 RFS US OOS. KR transfer prior probability moderate.
